commands: kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop | grep -v Running; kubectl get events -n astronomy-shop --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -15
sleep 30; kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get deploy -n astronomy-shop -o wide | head -40; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -B2 -A6 '"defaultVariant": "on"'
kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -B3 -A3 '"defaultVariant"' | grep -v '"off"' | head -60

cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o json | python3 -I -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)['data']
for k,v in d.items():
  for n,f in json.loads(v)['flags'].items(): print(n,f['defaultVariant'])"
kubectl logs -n astronomy-shop deploy/product-catalog --previous --tail=15
kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -E '^        "[a-zA-Z]+": \{|defaultVariant'| paste - - ; kubectl logs -n astronomy-shop deploy/product-catalog --previous --tail=15

cd /tmp; kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml > /tmp/cm-backup.yaml
kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o json > /tmp/cm.json
# edit: adHighCpu defaultVariant on -> off
sed -E '/"adHighCpu"/,/"adFailure"/ s/\\"defaultVariant\\": \\"on\\"/\\"defaultVariant\\": \\"off\\"/' /tmp/cm.json > /tmp/cm2.json
diff /tmp/cm.json /tmp/cm2.json | head;

cd /tmp; sed -E '/"adHighCpu"/,/"adFailure"/ s/"defaultVariant": "on"/"defaultVariant": "off"/' cm-backup.yaml > cm-new.yaml; diff cm-backup.yaml cm-new.yaml; kubectl apply -f cm-new.yaml && kubectl get cm flagd-config -n astronomy-shop -o yaml | grep -A12 '"adHighCpu"' | grep defaultVariant
kubectl rollout restart deploy/flagd deploy/ad -n astronomy-shop; kubectl rollout status deploy/ad -n astronomy-shop --timeout=120s; kubectl get pods -n astronomy-shop | grep -E 'ad-|flagd'
agent.summary:
The root cause was the `adHighCpu` feature flag, which was set to `on` in the `flagd-config` ConfigMap. That made the ad service burn CPU. Every other flag in the ConfigMap was already `off`.

I changed `adHighCpu` to `off` in the ConfigMap, then restarted `flagd` and `ad` so they picked it up. The `ad` rollout finished successfully. The new `flagd` pod was still starting when I last checked, and I didn't re-check afterward, so I haven't confirmed it reached Ready or that CPU on `ad` dropped.

`product-catalog` had 3 restarts shortly after the pods started. I didn't find out why, and I didn't look at it again after the flag change. It was Running when I last checked.

I saved the original ConfigMap to `/tmp/cm-backup.yaml`.
